title_o: The effects of an implemental mind-set on attitude strength.
verdict_reason: The script reads reconciling.for.repro.txt (skip 3 header lines); 70 rows flagged Include, ambivalence index from three items; one-way 3-group ANOVA gives F(2,67)=1.70, p=.191, eta^2=.048 as the table.

data_files.notes: tab-separated, 3 summary lines above the header; Include column; free-text responses inside

key_test.test: one-way between-subjects ANOVA of ambivalence (mean of StrongMixed, -NotTorn, Indecisive-4) across 3 conditions

obstacles: getOSFfile() is sourced from http://sachaepskamp.com/files/OSF/getOSFfile.R (external, not run); script not runnable offline as written

one participant lacks Indecisive; script imputes via Data[49,33] <- (Data[49,22]+Data[49,22])/2, which uses one column twice and only gives the right value by coincidence (dropping the case gives p=.229)
omnibus is 3-group although the description names one-sided vs two-sided only
